definition.en: A group of metabolic disorders characterized by chronic elevation of blood glucose.
definition.ps: دا د طبي زده کړې لنډه تشریح ده: A group of metabolic disorders characterized by chronic elevation of blood glucose.
definition.fa: خلاصه آموزشی: A group of metabolic disorders characterized by chronic elevation of blood glucose.

explanation.en: Diabetes results from problems with insulin production, insulin action, or both and requires ongoing monitoring and individualized management.
explanation.ps: د دې اصطلاح مهم معلومات د زده کړې لپاره په ساده ډول وړاندې کېږي.
explanation.fa: اطلاعات اصلی این اصطلاح برای مطالعه به شکل ساده ارائه می‌شود.

source: U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM) MeSH — educational summary

definition.en: A condition in which the thyroid gland produces insufficient thyroid hormone.

explanation.en: Hypothyroidism can affect metabolism and may cause fatigue, cold intolerance, and other systemic symptoms.

source: U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM) MeSH — educational summary
